name: physical-security-self-defense-and-firearms
description: Physical Security, Self-Defense, Firearms, and the ATF Substances -- people and buildings, force and law, and how alcohol, tobacco, cannabis and firearms actually intersect with medicine and self-defense -- with the source's limits carried into every skill: not legal advice, not medical advice, no dosing, and no substitute for hands-on training. Evidence-graded throughout (STRONG, MODERATE, WEAK, CONTESTED) and law-dated (LAW-2026: the legal state as of September 2026, to be verified). Threat modeling and what realistic risk looks like -- most violence comes from people you know, most burglaries are opportunistic, most gun deaths are suicides; the security mindset translated from information security, the fail-safe vs fail-secure egress tension, layered defense with time as the currency, and CPTED with the CCTV and lighting evidence. Home hardening in cost-effectiveness tiers from life safety first, organizations, access-control realities and authorized testing, and targeted violence with BTAM and Run-Hide-Fight. Personal security, domestic-violence and stalking safety planning, the self-defense hierarchy and de-escalation, the empowerment self-defense trial, less-lethal tools, and Stop the Bleed. Firearms treated conceptually and for safety, exactly as the source does -- the four safety rules, storage and the honest risk ledger with the contested defensive-gun-use numbers against the suicide evidence, training, carrying and the aftermath of an incident; federal law through United States v. Hemani and South Carolina's permitless-carry and self-defense statutes. Alcohol, tobacco and cannabis on mechanism, evidence-graded medical uses, harms, law and why intoxication and weapons do not mix; the self-medication problem; a personal security plan, spending priorities and the contested questions on both sides; and crisis lines, training resources, the glossary and the sources. Source defects, internal tensions and untagged legal statements are flagged in place with labelled pack notes, not silently repaired.
